summary: Iteration 47: Bug Fixes for Position Gone and Manual Position Sync - 32/32 tests passed. Verified TWO BUG FIXES: (1) POSITION GONE logic now finalizes positions as exchange_closed when execute_close fails 3x with 'Position not found' error, regardless of origin (manual or bot). Uses wider 3600s window for closedPnl lookup. Telegram alert sent. (2) Manual position sync now uses wider 7200s window (2 hours) for closedPnl evidence. If no evidence found, force-finalizes after exchange_closed_force_cycles (30 cycles). Logs every 10 cycles while waiting. All regression tests passed: bot positions still force-removed after 3 fails, MANUAL SAFE still blocks hard_sl/early_exit but allows trailing_exit/tp_cap/trend_exit.
